name: How long does it take to build a new bedroom addition?
description: Construction typically takes several weeks to a few months once underway, depending on permitting, foundation work, framing, and interior drywall finishes.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a new bedroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard ground-floor bedroom addition typically takes several weeks to a few months to complete once physical construction begins. The overall timeline depends on project complexity, architectural drawings, municipal permitting approvals, material procurement, and weather conditions. Site preparation, slab pouring, structural framing, exterior finishes like full-house stuccoing, and interior drywall require sequential inspections. Planning your design and securing permits before ordering materials helps minimize delays during active construction.
